item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Vernacular inscriptions from the Gallo-Italic area (13th-15th centuries): survey, critical edition and linguistic analysis (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/LIFI-01 Linguistica e filologia italiana

The research activity includes reviewing literature on Northern Italo-Romance vernacular inscriptions, specifically Gallo-Italic varieties, from the 13th to 15th centuries, conducting in situ surveys, managing data entry and cataloguing, as well as producing the scientific edition and linguistic commentary of the collected texts. The research is carried out within the framework of the FIS 3 project INCIDO - INscriptions in the Context of early Italian linguistic DOcumentation.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development of ArchaeologicalGeographicInformationSystems for the Sites of Abila and Machaerus, Jordan. Support for the Design of Exhibition Installations and Activities for the Dissemination of Scientific Findings from Archaeological Excavations (Univ. PERUGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/STAA-01 Culture e lingue antiche e moderne dell'africa e dell'asia occidentale e centrale

The project involves participation in archaeological excavations in Jordan and the development of dedicated Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for the archaeological sites of Abila and Machaerus, aimed at supporting scientific communication within the future archaeological parks. The project also includes the design and implementation of activities to disseminate its scientific findings in Jordan and Italy through the organization of temporary and/or permanent exhibitions within the new visitor centres to be established.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Documentation and Spatial Analysis of Late Middle to Early Upper Palaeolithic Sites Using GIS, Topographic Surveying and Archaeological Field Survey (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ARCH-01 Archeologia

The research will focus on the documentation and spatial analysis of Late Middle to Early Upper Palaeolithic sites within the ERC Last Neanderthals project. Activities will include excavation recording and archaeological field survey; topographic surveying using total stations and GNSS; GIS database development and management; photographic and photogrammetric documentation; and 3D surveying of caves, including point cloud acquisition and processing. Spatial data will be validated, analysed and integrated with archaeological, chronological and palaeoenvironmental evidence to investigate site organisation and landscape use. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: The Critical Reception of Polish Literature in Italy, 1861–1939 (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-19 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/SLAV-01 Slavistica

This research aims to reconstruct the critical reception of Polish literature in Italy from the Unification to the outbreak of the Second World War, with a focus on the periodical press. The study will identify and analyze various forms of critical reception—such as reviews, biographical pieces, promotional articles, and commentaries—within Italian literary and cultural journals, examining how Polish authors were presented and evaluated. It will also consider the extent to which this reception may have relied on foreign critical sources. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/FLMR-01 Filologie e letterature medio-latina e romanze

As part of a broader project that aims to systematically map and online catalog the corpus of anonymous works from the Latin Middle Ages (producing critical editions and commentaries where appropriate), this specific project intends to systematically explore the problem of pseudepigraphy in the second millennium, characterized by the emergence of new brands with an authorial function, often created using contemporary or quasi-contemporary authors (ps. Anselm, ps. Albert, ps. Arnold, ps. Bonaventure, ps. Joachim, ps. Thomas). item.title: Incarico di ricerca: 2026-IdrDip-06-stum - The teaching of Greek language and culture in Italian schools over recent decades: curricula, National Guidelines, teaching practices. (Univ. PAVIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 12:00
Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/HELL-01 Lingua e letteratura greca

This research programme, part of the broader project “School Culture” promoted by the Centre for Teacher Education at the University of Pavia, draws on the publication of the draft of the new NationalCurriculum Guidelines for upper-secondary schools and the intense debate that followed. It aims to contextualise Italian education policies regarding the teaching of Greek language and culture from the post-war period to the present day within the broader context of the cultural and symbolic meanings attributed to Greek ‘classicism’ at different times in contemporary European history. item.description:

Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ANGL-01 Anglistica e angloamericanistica
